name: gaa
description: GAA - Local agent orchestration with desktop and mobile clients

scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build:protocol && npm run bundle:daemon && npm run build:client:web && npm run prepare:assets --workspace @gaa/desktop
scripts.desktop:run: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run start --workspace @gaa/desktop
scripts.desktop:installer: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run installer --workspace @gaa/desktop
